title: Bengali Numbers
summary: The numbers zero through twelve in Bengali.

phrases.en: My number of mistakes is zero.
I have one book.
There are two cups of tea on the table.
We are three friends.
This room has four windows.
There are five mangoes in the basket.
Our team has six players.
There are seven days in a week.
School starts at eight in the morning.
The bus comes at nine.
Please wait ten minutes.
There are eleven students in the class.
There are twelve months in a year.
Say: “My number of mistakes is zero.”
